title: canary-rollout-scratchpad-alex-garcia
content:
Canary rollout scratchpad - Alex Garcia

Purpose:
- Sketch out quick checklist and execution notes for upcoming canary of runtime v2.3.1 + model redwood-v1.2.
- Capture abort/rollback criteria, monitoring queries, and version-pinning reminders.

Context / constraints:
- Target service: hosted-api / text-generation route 'generate-v1'
- Canary window: 2026-02-29 10:00 - 2026-03-01 18:00 PST (business hours overlap with SRE oncall)
- Traffic source: internal traffic split by routing policy, start with 1% user traffic (gradual ramp to 10%)
- Infra: dedicated inference pool for canary (gpu-pool-canary), fallback to pool-default if capacity issues
- Model: redwood-v1.2 (quantized int4 profile q4_0), runtime: serving-runtime v2.3.1

Assumptions:
- CI green for release branch; integration smoke tests passed (PR #78).
- Observability dashboards have baseline captured in last week; synthetic traffic script ready (scripts/canary-synth.sh).
- SLOs: p95 latency <= 220ms, error rate < 0.5% for generation endpoint under current load.

High-level steps (quick runbook):
1) Pre-checks (T-60m):
   - Ensure deployment artifact tagged: release/v2.3.1 (confirm in registry)
   - Confirm model bundle pinned in config: model: redwood-v1.2@2026-02-20 (pin hash: abc1234)
   - Validate feature flags: feature.canary-routing = enabled for canary pool only
   - Notify SRE + product (Slack #release-notify) with start time and rollback window

2) Deploy (T-30m):
   - Deploy runtime v2.3.1 to gpu-pool-canary using deploy/runbook/deploy-canary.sh
   - Smoke test: run smoke-suite --env canary (expected: all green)
   - Start synthetic traffic: scripts/canary-synth.sh --qps 5

3) Traffic ramp (T+0m):
   - Phase A: route 1% production traffic to canary for 15m
   - Phase B: if stable, increase to 3% for 30m
   - Phase C: increase to 10% for 60m (only if metrics stable)
   - Manual gating points: must confirm at each phase in Slack thread with SRE

4) Monitoring & checks (continuous):
   - Latency: p50/p95/p99 per-route (Grafana: RouteGen > generate-v1 > latency)
   - Errors: 5xx count, client error spikes, model output errors (NACKs)
   - Quality: run small eval set (eval/canary-prompt-set.json) every 15m and compare BLEU/ROUGE/heuristic-score against baseline
   - Cost/throughput: tokens/sec, GPU utilization on canary pool
   - Traces: check for tail latencies and kernel fallback logs

Abort & rollback criteria (if any met during canary):
- Latency: p95 increases > 30% above baseline sustained for > 10m
- Errors: 5xx rate > 0.5% for > 5m or any spike > 1%
- Quality regression: eval-score drop >= 3 points relative to baseline on golden prompts
- Infrastructure: GPU OOMs, model loading failures, or repeated health-check failures (>=3 instances down)
- Any customer-facing incidents reported for routes impacted

Rollback steps (fast):
- Immediately toggle routing to remove canary (feature.canary-routing -> 0%)
- If automated fallback not configured, update routing policy to route to pool-default
- Trigger rollback script: deploy/rollback-to-v2.3.0.sh (if runtime regression confirmed)
- Open incident in PagerDuty if user impact observed; notify product and CS

Post-canary checklist (T+end):
- Hold short retrospective: what failed/what succeeded (15m)
- Capture anomalies: links to traces, PRs, and logs in Confluence notes
- If stable: schedule canary-to-prod doc for gradual rollout to wider capacity
- Update model pinning registry: if model changed, ensure model hash recorded in release manifest

Version pinning notes (reminder):
- Model pinning: always include model name + manifest hash + quant profile. Example: redwood-v1.2@abc1234:q4_0
- Runtime pinning: runtime/v2.3.1+patch (include commit SHA where possible)
- Config: routing-policy id + commit (cfg/routing/2026-02-28#45)
- If forcing fallback compatibility, ensure older model variants listed in compatible_models in release config

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we need canary for embeddings route as well? Product asks only generation for now.
- Confirm synthetic eval thresholds with ML QA (Maya) - action: @Maya to confirm expected eval delta thresholds
- Verify KMS key rotation window doesn't block canary (Kenji to confirm)
- Add automated rollback playbook to ops repo (low priority)

Notes to self (scrappy):
- If eval pipeline shows higher variance, increase sample size rather than abort immediately
- Keep Slack thread name: #canary-gen-2026-02-29-alex for easy search
- Save baseline dashboards snapshot to dashboard-snapshots/canary-2026-02-28.json

Quick checklist (checkbox style i copy to release channel):
- [ ] Tag release artifact (release/v2.3.1)
- [ ] Confirm model pin (redwood-v1.2@abc1234)
- [ ] Deploy to gpu-pool-canary
- [ ] Run smoke tests
- [ ] Start synth traffic
- [ ] Ramp 1% -> 3% -> 10%
- [ ] Monitor latency/error/quality; confirm at each gate
- [ ] Post-canary retrospective + publish notes

End of scratchpad.
